# Long-run behaviour of the 1-sided test under H0: simulated clinical trials # Shiny app: single file (app.R) # Display conventions follow the Type I and II Error (Power) Explorer. library(shiny) library(dplyr) library(tibble) library(purrr) library(ggplot2) library(plotly) if (FALSE) library(jsonlite) # used via jsonlite:: for downloads `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a max_trials <- 10000 # maximum number of simulated trials marker_limit <- 2000 # per-trial blocks up to this many trials, bin-level bars above # ── Core calculations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Two-arm trial, equal allocation, common SD, true effect 0 (H0), 1-sided test. # Patient-level data are simulated for every trial. t-test: pooled-variance t # statistic (2n - 2 df). Normal approximation: z statistic using the true SD. sim_trials <- function(nsim, n, sd, normal = FALSE) { se_fac <- sqrt(2 / n) vapply(seq_len(nsim), function(i) { x <- rnorm(n, 0, sd) # control arm y <- rnorm(n, 0, sd) # treatment arm d <- mean(y) - mean(x) if (normal) d / (sd * se_fac) else d / (sqrt((var(x) + var(y)) / 2) * se_fac) }, numeric(1)) } pval_fun <- function(stat, df, normal = FALSE) { if (normal) pnorm(stat, lower.tail = FALSE) else pt(stat, df, lower.tail = FALSE) } crit_fun <- function(alpha, df, normal = FALSE) { if (normal) qnorm(1 - alpha) else qt(1 - alpha, df) } dens_fun <- function(x, df, normal = FALSE) { if (normal) dnorm(x) else dt(x, df) } # Freedman-Diaconis width, 2 x IQR x n^(-1/3), with the IQR of the null # distribution of the statistic, rounded to 2 significant figures. fd_width <- function(nsim, df, normal = FALSE) { q <- if (normal) qnorm(0.75) else qt(0.75, df) signif(2 * (2 * q) * nsim^(-1 / 3), 2) } # Monte Carlo error line for the summary box. Under H0 with an exact test the # number of rejections is Binomial(k, alpha), so the SE of the observed # proportion is sqrt(alpha (1 - alpha) / k). mc_line <- function(n_ge, k, alpha, dp) { if (k < 1) return(NULL) se <- sqrt(alpha * (1 - alpha) / k) lo <- max(0, alpha - 1.96 * se) hi <- min(1, alpha + 1.96 * se) z <- (n_ge / k - alpha) / se sprintf(paste0( "Monte Carlo error: SE of the proportion = %s. If the test is exact, 95%% ", "of simulations of this size give a proportion between %s and %s. ", "Observed proportion is %+.1f SE from alpha."), formatC(se, format = "f", digits = dp + 1), formatC(lo, format = "f", digits = dp), formatC(hi, format = "f", digits = dp), z) } # Decimal places for proportions: set by the size of the simulation, so that # 10 trials gives 1 place, 100 gives 2 and 10000 gives 4 dp_fun <- function(nsim) max(1, ceiling(log10(nsim))) stat_label <- function(s) if (s$normal) "z-statistic" else "t-statistic" # "Nice" major tick spacing (1, 2, 5 x 10^k) giving roughly `target` ticks nice_dtick <- function(width, target = 10) { raw <- width / target mag <- 10^floor(log10(raw)) m <- raw / mag mag * if (m < 1.5) 1 else if (m < 3.5) 2 else if (m < 7.5) 5 else 10 } # Colours. red_col matches alpha_col in the power explorer, without transparency. red_col <- "rgb(177, 69, 53)" grey_col <- "rgb(110, 110, 110)" # ── Help tooltip helper (same approach as the power explorer) ───────────────── help_icon <- function(text) { tags$span( "\u24d8", class = "help-icon", tabindex = "0", role = "button", `data-toggle` = "popover", `data-bs-toggle` = "popover", `data-trigger` = "focus", `data-bs-trigger` = "focus", `data-placement` = "right", `data-bs-placement` = "right", `data-content` = text, `data-bs-content` = text, style = "cursor: pointer; color: #337ab7; margin-left: 6px; font-weight: bold;" ) } labelled <- function(label, help) { tags$div( style = "display:flex; align-items:center;", tags$label(label, style = "margin-bottom: 0;"), help_icon(help) ) } n_help <- paste0( "Patients per arm (one value). Each simulated trial draws N patients per arm ", "from a normal distribution with mean 0 (H0 true) and the SD below." ) test_help <- paste0( "t-test: pooled-variance t statistic with 2n - 2 degrees of freedom, compared ", "with the central t distribution. Normal approximation: z statistic using the ", "true SD, compared with the standard normal distribution." ) alpha_help <- paste0( "1-sided significance level. The dashed vertical line is the critical value ", "for this alpha. It can be changed without re-simulating." ) ntr_help <- paste0("Number of simulated trials, 1 to ", max_trials, ".") seed_help <- paste0( "Random seed. The same seed and settings reproduce the same trials. Change ", "the seed, then click Simulate, for a fresh set." ) units_help <- paste0( "Bar height as a count of trials or as a percentage of all simulated trials. ", "The default is counts below 20 trials and percentages from 20 trials upwards; ", "it is switched when a simulation crosses that threshold." ) bw_help <- paste0( "Bar width in units of the test statistic. Leave empty for the ", "Freedman-Diaconis default, 2 x IQR x trials^(-1/3), with the IQR taken from ", "the null distribution and rounded to 2 significant figures." ) # ── UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ui <- fluidPage( tags$head( # Tell the server when plotly.js and crosstalk are loaded, so plots are not drawn too early tags$script(HTML(paste0("$(document).on('shiny:connected', function(){", "var t=setInterval(function(){", "if (typeof Plotly!=='undefined' && typeof crosstalk!=='undefined') {", "clearInterval(t); Shiny.setInputValue('plotly_ready', true);}}, 100);});"))), tags$script(HTML(paste0("$(document).on('shiny:connected', function(){", "Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('save_file', function(m){", "var bin=atob(m.b64), n=bin.length, bytes=new Uint8Array(n);", "for (var i=0;i max_trials) { msg <- paste0("Number of trials must be between 1 and ", max_trials, ".") } if (!is.null(msg)) { showNotification(msg, type = "error") return() } n <- as.integer(round(n)) nsim <- as.integer(round(nsim)) normal <- input$test == "normal" df <- 2L * n - 2L set.seed(as.integer(seed)) ts <- sim_trials(nsim, n, sd, normal) rv$sim <- list(t = ts, p = pval_fun(ts, df, normal), n = n, sd = sd, nsim = nsim, seed = as.integer(seed), normal = normal, df = df) # Bar height default: counts below 20 trials, percentages from 20 upwards. # Switched only when a simulation crosses the threshold. side <- nsim >= 20 if (!identical(side, rv$side)) { updateRadioButtons(session, "units", selected = if (side) "pct" else "count") rv$side <- side } if (isTRUE(input$animate)) { rv$k <- 0 rv$running <- TRUE } else { rv$k <- nsim rv$running <- FALSE } }) # ── Animation: add trials in steps until all are shown ────────────────────── observe({ req(rv$running) s <- isolate(rv$sim) frames <- min(s$nsim, 60) step <- ceiling(s$nsim / frames) invalidateLater(if (frames <= 20) 300 else 100, session) isolate({ k <- min(rv$k + step, s$nsim) rv$k <- k if (k >= s$nsim) rv$running <- FALSE }) }) # ── Bar width ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── bw_override <- reactive({ bw <- input$bw if (!is.null(bw) && length(bw) == 1 && !is.na(bw) && bw > 0) bw else NULL }) bar_w <- reactive({ s <- rv$sim req(s) bw_override() %||% fd_width(s$nsim, s$df, s$normal) }) output$bw_used <- renderUI({ s <- rv$sim req(s) tags$small(sprintf( "Bar width in use: %s (%s).", format(bar_w()), if (is.null(bw_override())) "Freedman-Diaconis default" else "user override" )) }) # ── Display size ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── output$dyn_css <- renderUI({ s <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$text_size)) / 100 if (length(s) != 1 || is.na(s)) s <- 1 px <- function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "px") tags$style(HTML(paste0( ".well, .well label, .well .control-label, .well .checkbox, .well .radio, ", ".well .btn, .well .form-control, .well .selectize-input, ", ".well .selectize-dropdown, .well .irs { font-size: ", px(14 * s), "; }\n", ".well .form-control { height: ", px(34 * s), "; padding: ", px(6 * s), " ", px(12 * s), "; }\n", ".well .form-group { margin-bottom: ", px(6 * s), "; }\n", ".well .checkbox, .well .radio { margin-top: ", px(2 * s), "; margin-bottom: ", px(2 * s), "; }\n", ".well hr { margin-top: ", px(6 * s), "; margin-bottom: ", px(6 * s), "; }\n", ".well { padding: ", px(10 * s), "; }" ))) }) plot_scale_r <- debounce( reactive(if (is.null(input$plot_scale)) 100 else input$plot_scale), 400 ) plot_f <- reactive(max(plot_scale_r() / 100, 0.7)) output$dyn_plot_css <- renderUI({ s <- plot_scale_r() / 100 tagList( tags$style(HTML(paste0("#plot { height: ", round(620 * s), "px !important; }"))), tags$script(HTML(paste0( "setTimeout(function(){ window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 100);", "setTimeout(function(){ window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 500);" ))) ) }) alpha_ok <- reactive({ !is.null(input$alpha) && !is.na(input$alpha) && input$alpha > 0 && input$alpha < 0.5 }) # ── Summary box ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── output$summary_box <- renderUI({ s <- rv$sim req(s, alpha_ok()) k <- min(rv$k, s$nsim) alpha <- input$alpha crit <- crit_fun(alpha, s$df, s$normal) slab <- stat_label(s) n_ge <- sum(s$t[seq_len(k)] >= crit) line1 <- sprintf("Trials simulated: %d of %d%s.", k, s$nsim, if (isTRUE(rv$running)) " (animation running)" else "") line2 <- if (k == 0) { sprintf("Trials with %s \u2265 critical value (%s): none simulated yet.", slab, formatC(crit, format = "f", digits = 3)) } else { sprintf( "Trials with %s \u2265 critical value (%s): frequency %d, proportion %s (%s%%).", slab, formatC(crit, format = "f", digits = 3), n_ge, formatC(n_ge / k, format = "f", digits = dp_fun(s$nsim)), formatC(100 * n_ge / k, format = "f", digits = max(0, dp_fun(s$nsim) - 2)) ) } line3 <- sprintf( "Expected under H0 (1-sided alpha = %s): proportion %s, about %s trials.", format(alpha, scientific = FALSE), format(alpha, scientific = FALSE), formatC(alpha * k, format = "f", digits = 1) ) tags$div( style = paste0("margin: 10px 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ccc; ", "border-radius: 4px; background: #fafafa;"), line1, tags$br(), tags$b(line2), tags$br(), line3, if (k > 0) tagList(tags$br(), mc_line(n_ge, k, alpha, dp_fun(s$nsim))) ) }) # ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── output$plot <- renderPlotly({ req(isTRUE(input$plotly_ready)) s <- rv$sim req(s) validate(need(alpha_ok(), "alpha (1-sided) must be between 0 and 0.5.")) k <- min(rv$k, s$nsim) # guard against a stale k after re-simulating alpha <- input$alpha f <- plot_f() w <- bar_w() crit <- crit_fun(alpha, s$df, s$normal) pct <- identical(input$units, "pct") u <- if (pct) 100 / s$nsim else 1 # height of one trial slab <- stat_label(s) f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2) f3 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3) fp <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "g", digits = 3) # Axis ranges come from the full set of trials, so nothing moves while animating q <- if (s$normal) qnorm(0.9995) else qt(0.9995, s$df) m <- max(abs(c(s$t, crit, q))) + w xr <- c(-m, m) xs <- seq(-m, m, length.out = 501) ycv <- (if (pct) 100 else s$nsim) * w * dens_fun(xs, s$df, s$normal) ymax <- 1.12 * max(max(table(round(s$t / w))) * u, ycv) # Trials shown so far, assigned to bins centred on multiples of w d <- tibble(t = s$t[seq_len(k)], p = s$p[seq_len(k)]) |> mutate(bin = round(t / w), ge = t >= crit) if (s$nsim <= marker_limit) { # One block per trial, stacked within its bin (trials below the critical # value first, so those at or above it sit on top) d <- d |> arrange(bin, ge, t) |> group_by(bin) |> mutate(pos = row_number()) |> ungroup() |> mutate(x = bin * w, base = (pos - 1) * u, txt = sprintf("%s: %s
1-sided p-value: %s", slab, f3(t), fp(p))) mk <- function(df) list(x = df$x, y = rep(u, nrow(df)), base = df$base, text = df$txt) lo <- mk(filter(d, !ge)) hi <- mk(filter(d, ge)) # White outlines only when blocks are tall enough to show them; with # many trials each block is a thin sliver and the outline hides the fill lw <- if (s$nsim <= 100) 1 else if (s$nsim <= 400) 0.5 else 0 } else { # Bin-level bars b <- d |> group_by(bin) |> summarise(n_lo = sum(!ge), n_hi = sum(ge), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(n = n_lo + n_hi, x = bin * w, txt = sprintf( "Bin: %s to %s
Count: %d
1-sided p-value at bin centre: %s", f3(x - w / 2), f3(x + w / 2), n, fp(pval_fun(x, s$df, s$normal)))) b_lo <- filter(b, n_lo > 0) b_hi <- filter(b, n_hi > 0) lo <- list(x = b_lo$x, y = b_lo$n_lo * u, base = rep(0, nrow(b_lo)), text = b_lo$txt) hi <- list(x = b_hi$x, y = b_hi$n_hi * u, base = b_hi$n_lo * u, text = b_hi$txt) lw <- 0.5 } add_blocks <- function(p, z, name, color) { empty <- length(z$x) == 0 if (empty) { # Zero-height placeholder keeps the legend entry without NA values, # which make plotly warn "Ignoring 1 observations" z <- list(x = 0, y = 0, base = 0, text = "") } add_trace( p, type = "bar", x = z$x, y = z$y, base = z$base, width = w, name = name, text = z$text, textposition = "none", hoverinfo = if (empty) "skip" else "text", marker = list(color = color, line = list(color = "white", width = lw)), hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = color, font = list(color = "white")) ) } p <- plot_ly() |> add_blocks(lo, paste0(slab, " < critical value"), grey_col) |> add_blocks(hi, paste0(slab, " \u2265 critical value"), red_col) if (isTRUE(input$show_curve)) { p <- p |> add_trace( type = "scatter", mode = "lines", x = xs, y = ycv, name = if (s$normal) "Expected under H0 (standard normal)" else paste0("Expected under H0 (central t, df = ", s$df, ")"), line = list(color = "black", width = 2), hoverinfo = "skip" ) } ttl <- paste0( "Simulated ", slab, "s under H0: ", s$nsim, " trials, N = ", s$n, " per arm
SD = ", s$sd, ", 1-sided alpha = ", alpha, if (s$normal) ", normal approximation" else ", t-test", ", seed = ", s$seed, ", bar width = ", format(w), "" ) p |> layout( font = list(size = 12 * f), title = list(text = ttl, font = list(size = 14 * f)), hovermode = "closest", barmode = "overlay", bargap = 0, xaxis = list( title = list(text = slab, standoff = 10), range = xr, zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = "black", linewidth = 1, ticks = "outside", showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#D0D0D0", tick0 = 0, dtick = nice_dtick(diff(xr)), minor = list(dtick = nice_dtick(diff(xr)) / 2, showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#EDEDED") ), yaxis = list( title = list(text = if (pct) "% of trials" else "Number of trials", standoff = 10), range = c(0, ymax), zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = "black", linewidth = 1, ticks = "outside", showgrid = isTRUE(input$gridlines), gridcolor = "#D0D0D0", tick0 = 0, dtick = if (pct) nice_dtick(ymax, 8) else max(1, nice_dtick(ymax, 8)), ticksuffix = if (pct) "%" else "" ), shapes = list(list( type = "line", xref = "x", x0 = crit, x1 = crit, yref = "paper", y0 = 0, y1 = 1, line = list(dash = "dash", color = "black", width = 1) )), annotations = list(list( xref = "x", yref = "paper", x = crit, xanchor = "center", y = 1, yanchor = "bottom", align = "center", showarrow = FALSE, text = paste0("Critical value = ", f2(crit), "
1-sided alpha = ", alpha), font = list(size = 11 * f) )), legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", yref = "container", y = 0.01, yanchor = "bottom"), margin = list(t = 115 * f, b = 135 * f, r = 30) ) |> config( displaylogo = FALSE, toImageButtonOptions = list(format = "png", filename = "simulated_trials_under_H0", width = 1400, height = 800, scale = 2) ) }) # ── CSV download ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Saves files through the browser (base64 + Blob). Shiny's own download links do not # work in shinylive/webR. send_file <- function(name, mime, writer) { f <- tempfile(); on.exit(unlink(f)) writer(f) session$sendCustomMessage("save_file", list(name = name, mime = mime, b64 = jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(f, "raw", file.size(f))))) } on_save <- function(btn, name, mime, writer) observeEvent(input[[btn]], { tryCatch(send_file(name(), mime, writer), error = function(e) showNotification(paste("Download failed:", conditionMessage(e)), type = "error", duration = NULL)) }) on_save("dl_csv", function() paste0("simulated_trials_under_H0_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), ".csv"), "text/csv", function(f) { s <- rv$sim if (is.null(s)) stop("Run a simulation first.") if (!alpha_ok()) stop("alpha (1-sided) must be between 0 and 0.5.") alpha <- input$alpha crit <- crit_fun(alpha, s$df, s$normal) tibble( Trial = seq_along(s$t), Statistic = s$t, P_value_1sided = s$p, Ge_critical = s$t >= crit, Critical_value = crit, Alpha_1sided = alpha, N_per_arm = s$n, SD = s$sd, Test = if (s$normal) "normal approximation" else "t-test", Seed = s$seed ) |> write.csv(f, row.names = FALSE) }) text_page <- function(lines) { lines <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(l) if (nzchar(l)) strwrap(l, width = 105) else "")) grid::grid.newpage() grid::grid.text(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), x = grid::unit(0.5, "in"), y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(0.5, "in"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)) } # Static version of the plot for the PDF (plotly cannot be written to PDF from R) sim_gg <- function() { s <- rv$sim if (is.null(s)) stop("Run a simulation first.") if (!alpha_ok()) stop("alpha (1-sided) must be between 0 and 0.5.") alpha <- input$alpha w <- bar_w() crit <- crit_fun(alpha, s$df, s$normal) pct <- identical(input$units, "pct") u <- if (pct) 100 / s$nsim else 1 slab <- stat_label(s) q <- if (s$normal) qnorm(0.9995) else qt(0.9995, s$df) m <- max(abs(c(s$t, crit, q))) + w xs <- seq(-m, m, length.out = 501) ycv <- (if (pct) 100 else s$nsim) * w * dens_fun(xs, s$df, s$normal) d <- tibble(t = s$t) |> mutate(bin = round(t / w), ge = t >= crit) |> count(bin, ge) |> mutate(x = bin * w, y = n * u, grp = factor(ifelse(ge, paste0(slab, " >= critical value"), paste0(slab, " < critical value")), levels = c(paste0(slab, " < critical value"), paste0(slab, " >= critical value")))) p <- ggplot(d, aes(x, y, fill = grp)) + geom_col(width = w, colour = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6E6E6E", "#B14535"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) + geom_vline(xintercept = crit, linetype = "dashed") + annotate("text", x = crit, y = Inf, vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.05, size = 3.3, label = paste0("Critical value = ", formatC(crit, format = "f", digits = 2))) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-m, m)) + labs(x = slab, y = if (pct) "% of trials" else "Number of trials", title = paste0("Simulated ", slab, "s under H0: ", s$nsim, " trials, N = ", s$n, " per arm"), subtitle = paste0("SD = ", s$sd, ", 1-sided alpha = ", alpha, if (s$normal) ", normal approximation" else ", t-test", ", seed = ", s$seed, ", bar width = ", format(w))) + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") if (isTRUE(input$show_curve)) { p <- p + geom_line(data = data.frame(x = xs, y = ycv), aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) } p } sim_lines <- function() { s <- rv$sim alpha <- input$alpha k <- s$nsim crit <- crit_fun(alpha, s$df, s$normal) slab <- stat_label(s) n_ge <- sum(s$t >= crit) c(sprintf("Long-run behaviour of the 1-sided test under H0: %d simulated trials.", k), sprintf("N = %d per arm, SD = %s, %s, 1-sided alpha = %s, seed = %d.", s$n, format(s$sd), if (s$normal) "normal approximation" else "t-test", format(alpha, scientific = FALSE), s$seed), "", sprintf("Trials with %s >= critical value (%s): frequency %d, proportion %s (%s%%).", slab, formatC(crit, format = "f", digits = 3), n_ge, formatC(n_ge / k, format = "f", digits = dp_fun(k)), formatC(100 * n_ge / k, format = "f", digits = max(0, dp_fun(k) - 2))), sprintf("Expected under H0 (1-sided alpha = %s): proportion %s, about %s trials.", format(alpha, scientific = FALSE), format(alpha, scientific = FALSE), formatC(alpha * k, format = "f", digits = 1)), mc_line(n_ge, k, alpha, dp_fun(k))) } on_save("dl_pdf", function() "simulated_trials_under_H0.pdf", "application/pdf", function(f) { g <- sim_gg(); l <- sim_lines() pdf(f, width = 10, height = 7); on.exit(dev.off()) print(g); text_page(l) }) } # ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
